fields.description: What the course is called, as learners will see it.
fields.label: Course Title

fields.description: The web address segment for this course, e.g. /training/backwash-basics. Derived from the title, editable while the course is a draft, and frozen once published so a link in an old assignment email never breaks.
fields.label: Slug

fields.description: Driven by the publish flow, not typed. Draft while being written, In Review once submitted for approval, Published once a version is live, Retired when withdrawn.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: Required courses are assigned with a due date and can be recertified and escalated. Optional courses sit in the self-serve library — progress is still recorded, but nobody is chased.
fields.label: Weight

fields.description: The version learners currently see. Set by the publish flow.
fields.label: Live Version

fields.description: Roughly how long the course takes. Computed at publish from the lessons; shown on the course card so a learner can judge whether they have time now.
fields.label: Estimated Minutes

fields.description: A sentence or two on what someone will be able to do after taking this.
fields.label: Summary

fields.description: Internal staff, customers on the portal, or both. Never put internal safety or compliance content on a customer-facing course.
fields.label: Audience

fields.description: Let people start this from the library without being assigned it.
fields.label: Allow Self-Enrolment

fields.description: Limit the course to holders of these roles. Leave empty to show it to every internal learner.
fields.label: Visible To Roles

fields.description: Raise assignments automatically from the rules below when someone is hired or changes department, designation or role profile.
fields.label: Assign Automatically

fields.description: Days a learner gets to finish after it is assigned. Leave at 0 to use the Training Settings default.
fields.label: Due In (Days)

fields.description: Reassign this course every N months. 0 means it never expires.
fields.label: Recertify Every (Months)

fields.description: Days past the due date before the escalation role is told. Leave at 0 to use the Training Settings default.
fields.label: Escalate After (Days)

fields.description: Who hears about it when this course goes overdue.
fields.label: Escalation Role

fields.description: Who owes this course. Each row resolves to a set of people; someone matched by two rows is still only assigned once.
fields.label: Assignment Rules

fields.description: Score needed to pass the quizzes.
fields.label: Passing Score

fields.description: Quiz attempts before a learner needs a Training Manager to reset them. 0 means unlimited.
fields.label: Quiz Attempts

fields.description: How much of each video must be watched. This measures time spent with the video playing and visible — not attention. Someone can start it and walk away, which is why it is never the only gate.
fields.label: Minimum Watched (%)

fields.description: Require every in-video checkpoint to have been answered before the lesson can be finished.
fields.label: All Checkpoints Answered

fields.description: Some things cannot be proved by a quiz. Tick this to require a named supervisor to confirm the learner can actually do it before the course counts as complete.
fields.label: Require Sign-off

fields.description: Who signs: the learner's manager, one named person, or whichever Training Manager picks it up.
fields.label: Who Signs Off
fields.options:
Reports To
Named Supervisor
Any Training Manager

fields.description: Exactly what the supervisor is attesting to. Write it as an observable action — "can drain and refill a basin unsupervised", not "understands basins".
fields.label: What To Verify

fields.description: How long the certificate stays valid. 0 means it never expires.
fields.label: Valid For (Months)
